about.title: ABOUT ME®
about.description: UX designer with systems thinking and a front-end perspective. Specialist in scalable Design Systems (Atomic Design) with advanced Figma structures focused on technical handoff. I optimize product flows through AI-Driven Design, using artificial intelligence to accelerate user research synthesis, ideation, and rapid prototyping. I build interactive, high-conversion products that are strictly accessible (WCAG/ARIA).

1.feedback: Eduardo is a standout designer — creative and extremely skilled. He's able to capture exactly what a client has in mind and turn it into high-level work. When given creative freedom, he goes beyond expectations and surprises with the details. From the simplest to the most complex projects, he knows how to combine elements in a clean, modern, and impactful way. His work stands out for its quality, visual organization, and great taste. Without a doubt, an excellent professional who always delivers more than expected.

2.feedback: I've had great experiences working with Eduardo as a designer. He's always shown creativity, attention to detail, and a lot of professionalism on every project. Beyond delivering quality work, he was helpful and open to feedback throughout the whole process. The final result always met my expectations, which is why I confidently recommend his work.

3.feedback: I had a great experience with Eduardo's work. I sent him an idea and a reference for the design of my senior class jacket, and he understood exactly what I wanted. The result was amazing, exceeding my expectations down to every detail. Besides being very talented, he's attentive and dedicated to what he does. I recommend his work to anyone looking for a creative and skilled designer.
